cohort: 709 women with preterm prelabor rupture of membranes (PPROM) and their neonates, delivering between gestational weeks 24+0 and 33+6.
finding: Maternal diabetes, maternal fever, positive urinary or vaginal/cervical culture, fetal tachycardia, and decreasing short-term variation were associated with an increased risk for Early-onset neonatal sepsis (EONS) in a population with preterm prelabor rupture of membranes (PPROM).
